text:
carla: FYI we're deploying a temporary quota smoothing + transitional invoice credit for hosted API next week to reduce 429 noise. Short thread.

mike: what's changing exactly?

carla: Two items: 1) 25s smoothing buffer at the API edge to absorb short spikes; 2) a transitional invoice credit (label CREDIT_SMTH_2026) for customers whose overage would otherwise be billed during the window. Not a permanent price change.

helen: rollout window?

carla: 2026-04-10 00:00 UTC -> 2026-04-24 23:59 UTC.

sre-bot: Ops note: smoothing queues short bursts, steady-state QPS still enforced. Auto-rollback if P95 latency +80ms.

billing-bot: Billing note: invoice JSON will include line item code CREDIT_SMTH_2026 and a policy_note smoothed-rollout-2026. Credits capped at $500 per acct for this rollout.

mike: any change to trials/free credits?

carla: Trials unchanged; if a trial expires during the window and causes overage, we apply pro-rata credit so customers aren't charged unexpectedly.

helen: action items:
- @mike: edge toggle + rollback PR by Wed.
- @billing-bot: confirm GL mapping and cap.
- @helen: support FAQ and console banner.

carla: customer email + in-console banner will go out before rollout. Escalate blockers to me.
